items.question: Choose the correct form: She ___ to the gym every morning.
items.explanation: Правильный ответ — goes, так как субъект she требует третьего лица единственного числа в Present Simple.

items.question: Which word is a synonym of 'happy'?
items.explanation: Joyful означает «радостный», синоним happy.

items.question: Complete the sentence: If it rains, we ___ stay at home.
items.explanation: В первом условном предложении после if present simple, в главной части will + инфинитив.

items.question: Choose the correct past tense: They ___ the movie last night.
items.explanation: Прошедшее простое время для регулярных глаголов образуется добавлением -ed.

items.question: Which sentence uses the present perfect correctly?
items.explanation: Present Perfect: have/has + V3; действие завершено, результат важен сейчас.

items.question: Select the correct preposition: She is good ___ playing the piano.
items.explanation: После good используется предлог at.

items.question: What is the plural of 'child'?
items.explanation: Неправильное множественное число: child → children.

items.question: Choose the correct article: ___ sun rises in the east.
items.explanation: Перед уникальными объектами (sun) используется определенный артикль the.

items.question: Which word is an adverb?
items.explanation: Adverb образуется добавлением -ly к прилагательному: quick → quickly.

items.question: Complete: I ___ to the party if I finish work early.
items.explanation: Первое условное: if + Present Simple, will + инфинитив.

items.question: Choose the correct form: He ___ not like spicy food.
items.explanation: В отрицании Present Simple для he/she/it используется does not.

options: The cake was eaten by the children.
The children are eating the cake.
items.question: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
items.explanation: Passive: be + V3; объект становится подлежащим.

items.question: Select the correct comparative: This book is ___ than that one.
items.explanation: Для длинных прилагательных сравнительная степень: more + adjective.

items.question: What is the correct question form: ___ you like coffee?
items.explanation: В вопросах Present Simple с I/you/we/they используется Do.

items.question: Choose the right modal for advice: You ___ see a doctor.
items.explanation: Should выражает совет или рекомендацию.

items.question: Which word means 'to make something better'?
items.explanation: Improve — улучшать, делать лучше.

items.question: Complete the sentence: By the time we arrived, the show ___.
items.explanation: Past Perfect используется для действия, завершившегося до другого прошлого действия.

items.question: Choose the correct pronoun: ___ is my brother.
items.explanation: Подлежащее лицо — He.

items.question: Which phrase uses the correct collocation?
items.explanation: Коллокация: make a decision.

items.question: Select the correct tense: She ___ (read) a book now.
items.explanation: Действие происходит сейчас → Present Continuous.

items.question: What is the opposite of 'expensive'?
items.explanation: Cheap — дешевый, антоним expensive.

items.question: Choose the correct form: They ___ been waiting for an hour.
items.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous: have/has been + V-ing.

items.question: Which sentence is correct?
items.explanation: Для he/she/it в отрицании Present Simple используется doesn't.

items.question: Complete: If I ___ you, I would tell the truth.
items.explanation: Второе условное: if + Past Simple (were для всех лиц), would + инфинитив.

items.question: Which word is a countable noun?
items.explanation: Apple — исчисляемое существительное.

items.question: Choose the correct preposition: I'm interested ___ learning Spanish.
items.explanation: После interested используется предлог in.

items.question: What is the past participle of 'write'?
items.explanation: Past participle неправильного глагола write — written.

items.question: Select the correct sentence: ___ you ever been to Paris?
items.explanation: Present Perfect вопрос: Have + подлежащее + V3.

items.question: Which modal expresses ability in the past?
items.explanation: Could — прошлое от can, выражает способность в прошлом.

items.question: Complete: She ___ to the store when it started to rain.
items.explanation: Действие шло в процессе в прошлом → Past Continuous.
